purpose: Build an explicit repository reference graph for the frozen C1 lifecycle-node population while separating retention-protecting references from informational mentions.

edgeSchema.multipleExplicitLocators: Group identical edge identities, retain the first sorted locator in sourceFieldOrLocator, and preserve the rest in additionalLocators.

referenceDiscovery.targetPopulation: Exact paths of C1 records with admissionStatus=ADMITTED only.
referenceDiscovery.sourceUniverse: Text-like blobs in the exact frozen baseline tree, including lifecycle nodes and non-node operational sources.
referenceDiscovery.jsonTraversal: Parse JSON and preserve explicit JSON-pointer locators; if a non-critical JSON file cannot parse, fall back to line scanning and record review.
referenceDiscovery.textTraversal: Scan literal repository text line-by-line for exact admitted-node path strings.

protectingSourcePolicy.statusSourceDeclaration: APPROVED Status Source declaration path fields protect referenced admitted nodes. All APPROVED source entries are operationally validated by current Status Source selection, including lineage predecessors.
protectingSourcePolicy.currentStatusSourceTarget: An admitted node used by an APPROVED Status Source entry, or a supplemental source declared by that entry, may protect explicit path/provenance/predecessor references in its structured fields.
protectingSourcePolicy.registeredValidatorEntrypoint: Registered validator entrypoints protect exact admitted-node paths only when the mention represents validator input/dependency use. A path used solely as a routing/example fixture does not become retention-protecting.
protectingSourcePolicy.currentToolContract: Contracts beneath tool roots reached by registered Project Check validator entrypoints protect only explicit semantic path locators.
protectingSourcePolicy.retentionDeclaration: C1 RETENTION_DECLARATION nodes protect explicit semantic path locators.
protectingSourcePolicy.activeWorkflow: A workflow protects exact admitted-node references only when current authority explicitly admits that workflow as active. C2 currently derives this from the frozen Status Source lifecycle transport/pipeline fields and retained APPROVED_FOR_HANDOFF producer declarations. Mere tracked workflow existence is not active-workflow authority.
protectingSourcePolicy.currentProductionConsumer: Tracked baseline src/app/pages sources protect exact literal admitted-node paths when directly referenced.
protectingSourcePolicy.manifest: C1 MANIFEST nodes protect explicit semantic path locators.
structuredSemanticPathLocators: path beneath an explicitly named predecessor/provenance/source/input/manifest/artifact/validation/checkpoint/contract/supplemental/consumer/authority/producer/output/generated object
activeWorkflowAdmissionSources: C1 RETENTION_DECLARATION nodes with state=APPROVED_FOR_HANDOFF and requestedByWorkflow

validatorRoutingFixtureException.basis: The frozen baseline self-test passes these literal paths to expectOwners/routeProjectCheckPaths to test routing; it does not require the referenced artifact contents as validator inputs.

protectingSourcePolicy.semanticPathLocatorRule: Structured protection recognizes explicit path/path(s) keys and semantic *SourcePath/*ManifestPath/*ValidationPath/*CheckpointPath/*ContractPath/*PredecessorPath/*InputPath/*ArtifactPath/*ConsumerPath/*AuthorityPath/*OutputPath/*GeneratedPath-style keys, including prefixed keys such as a5ManifestPath beneath predecessor objects.

informationalPolicy.default: Every exact admitted-node path mention that does not satisfy a protecting-source rule remains INFORMATIONAL.

refreshWhen: C1 admitted population or inventory digest changes.
Status Source declaration or active-source input changes.
Project Check validator catalog or npm validator entrypoint mapping changes.
Active workflow/current consumer/current tool contract sources change in a way that adds/removes exact admitted-node references.
Any baseline text source adds/removes an exact admitted-node path mention relevant to the graph.
Explicit current-workflow admission fields in Status Source lifecycle/declarations change.
freshness.incrementalPolicy: Recompute incoming/outgoing edges only for affected source paths and affected admitted targets when a future implementation supports delta refresh; full baseline rebuild is not the semantic authority.

nextStartPoint: Use protectingReferenceCount from C2 incoming records, not totalReferenceCount, together with explicit lifecycle evidence and classificationBasis[].
